description: This file defines the 'PortGuardian' actor responsible for monitoring, managing, and reporting network port usage within the OpenClaw application. It includes functionality to record port activity, scan for active listeners, issue kill commands, and generate port status reports. It also contains internal data structures such as 'Record', 'Listener', and 'ReportListener', as well as helper methods for process inspection and parsing listener data.
external_files: # Assumed external for process execution and command running.

classes.name: PortGuardian
classes.description: An actor that manages port monitoring, recording, and reporting functionalities within the application. Implements singleton pattern with 'shared' instance.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: A Codable struct representing an individual port activity record including port number, pid, command, mode, and timestamp.

classes.name: Descriptor
classes.description: A struct holding details about a process associated with a port, including pid, command, and optional executable path.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: A struct representing a network listener process with its pid, command, full command, and user.

classes.name: ReportListener
classes.description: A struct representing a listener in report context, including expected status.

classes.name: PortReport
classes.description: A struct for reporting the status of a port, including expectations, current listeners, and status details.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Asynchronously scans specified ports for listeners, kills unexpected ones based on mode, and logs actions.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Asynchronously records a port activity with its pid, command, mode, and timestamp, then saves to disk.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes records matching a given pid and updates the saved records.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Asynchronously provides a descriptor for a specific port, including pid, command, and executable path.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Asynchronously generates status reports for monitored ports.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealth
methods.description: Checks the health/status of the gateway via HTTP request.

methods.name: isListening
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a port (and optionally a specific pid) is actively listened to.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Runs 'lsof' to obtain list of listeners on a given port and parses the output.

methods.name: readFullCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the full command line of a process given its pid.

methods.name: buildReport
methods.description: Creates a PortReport object based on listeners, mode, and tunnel health.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Gets the executable path for a process pid on Darwin systems.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process by pid using kill signals.

methods.name: isExpected
methods.description: Determines if a listener is an expected process based on command and mode.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks if the gateway health needs probing and performs it if required.

methods.name: loadRecords
methods.description: Loads port records from a JSON file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes current port records to disk.
